items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I was in Chicago, I played Sam Morgan band was the first band.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Well, that's the slow ones that made the slaves slow, slow. Yeah. And everybody get together.

Yeah. But for our people, man, no, they don't go for that. They don't go for no ten cents to dance, man. No. Ain't gonna play. I see. You were talking more about the Sam Morgan or Isaiah Morgan bands.

What kind of a band? They made some records. I mean, when you played with them, what type of music did they play? They made some records of some spirituals for one thing. Yeah. Well, I was playing trumpet when they made that. I was in that place. I had my own band. You see? I just wondered, when you were a member, what type of music they played?

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Sam never, how they played the rough trumpet, he was on the sweet side.

ctx.x: Yeah, they played, yeah. I wondered because the first time you made your records you played the Climax Rag, which I've never heard of you before. Yeah. You seem to know all those old numbers. I know, man. Some of those with the Morgan Band things.
Yeah, well, yeah, but Morgan Band, well, Sam never, how they played the rough trumpet, he was on the sweet side.

He was on the sweet side. Yeah, he was sweet, straight, and he was on the right. Straight, sweet. Did they have an unusually good beat? A lot of people thought it was a wonderful dance band. It was a wonderful dance band.
